summary: Containerized certificate paths are under ~/aap (controller/etc/tower.cert, eda/etc/eda.cert, gateway/etc/gateway.cert, hub/etc/pulp.cert, postgresql/server.crt, receptor/etc/receptor.crt, redis/server.crt); after preparing them run ansible.containerized_installer.install and check with curl -vk for 'SSL certificate verify OK'.
questions: Where are the TLS certificates in a containerized AAP install?
Where is gateway.cert stored for containerized AAP?
How do I verify the new TLS certificate is in use?

answer_card.title: Containerized certificate file paths
answer_card.answer_md:
| Service | Cert | Key |
|---|---|---|
| Controller | `~/aap/controller/etc/tower.cert` | `tower.key` |
| EDA | `~/aap/eda/etc/eda.cert` | `eda.key` |
| Gateway | `~/aap/gateway/etc/gateway.cert` | `gateway.key` |
| Hub | `~/aap/hub/etc/pulp.cert` | `pulp.key` |
| PostgreSQL | `~/aap/postgresql/server.crt` | `server.key` |
| Receptor | `~/aap/receptor/etc/receptor.crt` | `receptor.key` |
| Redis | `~/aap/redis/server.crt` | `server.key` |

Apply: `ansible-playbook -i <inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.install`, then `curl -vk https://<host>:<port>/api/v2/`.
